description: Defines the 'Note' data model class with fields for note attributes, methods for copying, serialization/deserialization, and human-readable date formatting.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a note entity with local persistence fields including id, title, content, timestamps, and archive status.

methods.name: Note.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Note instance with optional updated fields.

methods.name: Note.toMap
methods.description: Serializes the Note object into a Map suitable for storage or transmission.

methods.name: Note.fromMap
methods.description: Deserializes a Map into a Note instance, handling missing values with defaults.

methods.name: Note.humanDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime into a human-readable string, indicating 'Today' if applicable.
